QuestInfo.name: Camila's Gem
QuestInfo.0: I heard that #p1012108# in Henesys is worrying about something...
QuestInfo.1: You meet #p1012108# in Henesys, and she asks you to deliver #b#t4031156##k to #b#p1012107##k for her, because she is afraid. You heard that you could get to #m900000000# through Way to the Beach...
QuestInfo.2: I delivered #p1012108# to #p1012107#. I'm sure they are really close friends, since they give what's most precious to them. I wish I could meet a friend like that during my journey...

1.0: Who are you? Whoa, isn't that the marble that #p1012108# so preciously takes care of? How did you get that??? What? #p1012108# asked you to get me that for my birthday? Wow, that's just awesome. This is a very precious item, you know. Now that the farming is almost done, I may have to go see #p1012108# to say thanks.

yes.0: Thanks for delivering Camila's present to me. Did you get my reward? Hopefully it'll help you on your journey.

npc.0: Oh, that crystal... did you not see Utah yet? Please get him the present before his birthday passes. Did you lose your way to his farm by any chance?
npc.1: Head to the Eastern forest of Henesys and you'll see an entrance to Utah's pig farm. Avoid the Ribbon Pigs and traps and navigate your way through the hidden paths, and you'll find him.

item.0: Who are you? This is our farm, and we raise a bunch of #o1210101#s. They are much stronger than the #o1210101#s that are raised out in the wild. Anyway, how can I help you?

lost.0: Ah, did you lose the marble that I gave you by any chance? Someone picked it up from the streets a couple of minutes ago. This is something I really cherish, so please take good care of it, and get it to Utah ASAP.

0.0: My friend #b#p1012107##k grew up with me and has a birthday coming up in a few days. So, I've decided my gift will be my precious #b#t4031156##k.
0.1: There's a problem, though. #p1012107# hasn't been coming uptown lately, probably because he's been swarmed with work. I'd like to go there and give it to him myself, but the #o1210101#s that he raises scare me to death. Well... if you have any time, can you get this marble to #p1012107# for me?

yes.0: Really? Thank you, thank you so much! Here's the marble. I even carved a message for #p1012107# on it. You can get to Utah's farm through the Way to the Beach. Good luck!

no.0: Oh, I see. Sorry for asking. You must be a very busy person... #p1012107# might be disappointed... sigh... what should I do now??
